subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-continuity Skill Workshop updates override the default automatic approval policy and require explicit operator approval before replacing SKILL.md?
rationale: The safety exception deliberately changes the user workflow established by the recently merged automatic-approval change, and source correctness alone cannot determine the intended approval contract.

options.title: Gate low-continuity replacements
options.body: Require explicit approval only when an update does not retain substantial existing skill content, while continuous edits remain automatic.

options.title: Preserve unconditional auto approval
options.body: Reject empty or structurally invalid skill bodies but auto-apply every structurally valid update regardless of continuity.

options.title: Require approval for every update
options.body: Make all Skill Workshop updates approval-gated, accepting a broader workflow regression for a simpler safety rule.

recommendation.title: Gate low-continuity replacements
recommendation.body: Require explicit approval only when an update does not retain substantial existing skill content, while continuous edits remain automatic.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the automatic-approval behavior whose permanent contract this PR changes.
